title: Unlocking Hidden Value: Clarify Your Commercial Real Estate Systems
excerpt: Discover the importance of clarifying your systems to unlock hidden value in commercial real estate. Start with "Clarify" to maximize your portfolio.
content:
Introduction: The Importance of Clarification

In the latest episode of the Peak Property Performance® Podcast, we delve into the crucial concept of "Clarify"—the first step in our PPP 5C™ framework. As commercial real estate (CRE) owners, understanding what systems you own and their worth is fundamental to unlocking hidden value in your portfolio. This episode is an eye-opener, illustrating how a bit of curiosity can lead to significant savings and new revenue streams.

Understanding the "Clarify" Concept

"Clarify" is all about knowing what you own, identifying where you're leaking value, and understanding your building's data worth. In the podcast, Bill Douglas and Drew Hall emphasize that owning your data & digital infrastructure is key. If you don't own it, your vendors do, potentially monetizing it without your knowledge or benefit.

"Know what you own, where you're leaking value, and what your data is really worth." — Drew Hall

Clarifying Ownership and Data Control

Bill and Drew share a pivotal discussion on the ownership and control of digital infrastructure. It's easy to overlook systems like HVAC, lighting, and security, assuming they're just operational expenses. However, these are critical components generating valuable data that should be harnessed for strategic gains.

"Do you know what you know, or do you not know what you don't know?" — Bill Douglas

Real-world examples highlight the importance of this. In one instance, a forgotten lighting control system, once clarified and activated, saved a building over $56,000 in its first year alone. This underscores the value of understanding and leveraging your existing systems.

The Role of Data in Modern CRE Systems

Modern systems are more modular and data-rich than ever. The key is ensuring that all potential data sources are connected and utilized. In the podcast, Drew elaborates on the importance of a robust digital infrastructure, which he likens to a "backbone" for your building's systems.

Every decision made by your systems—like when to turn on the air conditioning—is a data point that can provide insights into optimizing operations and enhancing tenant experiences.

Inquisitive Approach to System Optimization

Being inquisitive is crucial. In the episode, Bill recounts a story where a building engineer discovered an unused system simply by asking, "What is that?" This curiosity led to significant savings and operational enhancements.

It's about taking inventory and understanding each system's role and potential. As Drew points out, many systems are visible, making it easier to start this process. But the key lies in the details—knowing what each component can offer when fully utilized.

Case Study: Unlocking ROI Through Clarification

The story of the lighting control system that saved $56,000 is a perfect case study. It highlights the ROI potential when systems are clarified and optimized. This was achieved not by installing something new but by understanding and activating what was already in place.

This case exemplifies why digital infrastructure should be viewed as an investment rather than an expense. Properly managed, it can generate returns comparable to traditional real estate investments.

Preparing for the Next C: Connect

As we conclude our exploration of "Clarify," we prepare to delve into "Connect," the next step in the PPP 5C™ framework. Connection ensures that all clarified systems are integrated into a cohesive network, maximizing data flow and utility.

Stay tuned for the next episode, where we'll explore how connecting your infrastructure can further enhance your property performance.

For a deeper dive into these concepts, check out our book on Peak Property Performance® and consider a complimentary PPP Review to assess your building's data & digital infrastructure.
